templates.description: External-DNS for plain Docker hosts: watches running containers, reads dockroute.* labels and reconciles the matching DNS records — and Cloudflare Tunnel routes — in a pluggable provider. TXT-based ownership means it never alters records it cannot prove it manages. Source: https://github.com/Dockroute/Dockroute

env.label: DNS provider ('log' is a credential-free dry run that only prints the desired state)
env.name: DOCKROUTE_PROVIDER

env.label: Ownership id written to companion TXT records (lets several instances share a zone safely)
env.name: DOCKROUTE_OWNER_ID

env.label: Sync policy — sync creates/updates/deletes owned records, upsert-only never deletes, create-only never updates or deletes
env.name: DOCKROUTE_POLICY

env.label: Default target — fallback record value (IP or CNAME target) when a container omits the dockroute.target label
env.name: DOCKROUTE_DEFAULT_TARGET

env.label: Domain filter — comma-separated allowlist of DNS zones DockRoute may touch (blank = every zone the token can see)
env.name: DOCKROUTE_DOMAIN_FILTER

env.label: Resync interval in seconds (periodic full reconcile that backs up the event stream)
env.name: DOCKROUTE_RESYNC_SECONDS

env.label: Cloudflare API token — required when provider is cloudflare (Zone → DNS → Edit)
env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

env.label: Cloudflare account ID (only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing)
env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID

env.label: Cloudflare tunnel ID — an existing tunnel; you keep running cloudflared yourself (only needed for Tunnel publishing)
env.name: CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID

templates.name: dockroute
templates.note: Deploys with zero configuration: the entrypoint grants the app user the Docker socket's group and drops privileges before starting, and the default 'log' provider is a dry run that needs no credentials. Once the output looks right, switch DOCKROUTE_PROVIDER to cloudflare and set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Opt containers in with the labels dockroute.enabled=true and dockroute.hostname=app.example.com. Docs: https://www.dockroute.dev
templates.title: DockRoute
